WITH users AS (
  SELECT user_id, CAST(MIN(signup_date) AS DATE) AS signup
  FROM src GROUP BY user_id
), events AS (
  SELECT s.user_id, u.signup, CAST(s.activity_date AS DATE) AS activity
  FROM src AS s JOIN users AS u ON s.user_id = u.user_id
)
SELECT strftime(signup, '%Y-%m') AS cohort,
       date_diff('month', signup, activity) AS period,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS users
FROM events GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

recipe.name: cohort_analysis
recipe.description: Group users by signup month and report distinct active users per month since signup.
